alt: Title slide: Pulse — every seat hears the talk. Live captions, listen-in audio and a direct line to the room crew from any phone.
The problem: the back row is guessing. Can't hear, can't see, and no signal reaches the crew while the talk is happening.
How it works in four steps: scan the QR code, follow captions and listen-in audio, signal with Speak up or Can't see the slides, and the crew gets one ticket per issue.
Live demo: scan the title slide, speak into the mic, and tap Can't hear. The technician console opens a ticket for three people.
Tech stack: Kubernetes with Radar for deployment, Elastic for indexed captions and questions, Dash0 for traces and metrics, and Gitar for automated code review.
Thank you. Questions are welcome; scan the title slide to try Pulse live.
